# vyos.blueprints.bgp

BGP routing (IPv4 unicast)

- General BGP building block - local AS and router-id, announced networks, redistribution with metric or route-map, and neighbours with remote-as, update-source, timers and import/export route-maps.
- Used by the "High Availability Walkthrough" blueprint. For unnumbered fabrics use `vyos.blueprints.bgp_unnumbered`; for BGP over IPsec use the BGP options of `vyos.blueprints.ipsec_route_based`.
- Uses vyos_bgp_global and vyos_bgp_address_family only. Create referenced route-maps first, e.g. with `vyos.blueprints.route_policy`.
- Nothing is configured when `bgp_asn` is not set.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.bgp
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bgp_asn` | int |  |  | Local AS number. Nothing is configured when unset. |
| `bgp_router_id` | str |  | `''` | BGP router-id. |
| `bgp_networks` | list |  | `[]` | IPv4 prefixes to announce. |
| `bgp_log_neighbor_changes` | bool |  | `false` | Log neighbour changes. |
| `bgp_redistribute` | list |  | `[]` | Redistribution into BGP (IPv4 unicast). |
| `bgp_redistribute.type` | str | yes |  | Protocol, e.g. `connected`, `static`, `ospf`. |
| `bgp_redistribute.metric` | int |  |  | MED for redistributed routes. |
| `bgp_redistribute.route_map` | str |  |  | Route-map applied to redistributed routes. |
| `bgp_neighbors` | list |  | `[]` | Neighbours. |
| `bgp_neighbors.address` | str | yes |  | Neighbour address. |
| `bgp_neighbors.remote_as` | int | yes |  | Neighbour AS number. |
| `bgp_neighbors.description` | str |  |  | Neighbour description. |
| `bgp_neighbors.update_source` | str |  |  | Source address or interface. |
| `bgp_neighbors.ebgp_multihop` | int |  |  | eBGP multihop TTL. |
| `bgp_neighbors.password` | str |  |  | TCP MD5 password. |
| `bgp_neighbors.holdtime` | int |  |  | Hold time in seconds. |
| `bgp_neighbors.keepalive` | int |  |  | Keepalive in seconds. |
| `bgp_neighbors.disable_connected_check` | bool |  | `false` | Allow peering with a neighbour that is not directly connected. |
| `bgp_neighbors.soft_reconfiguration_inbound` | bool |  | `false` | Keep received routes for soft reconfiguration. |
| `bgp_neighbors.route_map_import` | str |  |  | Route-map for routes received from this neighbour. |
| `bgp_neighbors.route_map_export` | str |  |  | Route-map for routes sent to this neighbour. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every BGP session is established.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bgp_neighbors` | list |  | `[]` | Same value as for `main`. |
